script: I crashed my ex's 21st, she exploded—now I am stuck in a nightmare.. I was at her house for her 21st, still riding the "friends after break‑up" wave—she even had a Florida trip planned with me. I brought a bag full of her favorite things and inside jokes, like the perfect gift for a bestie who's still my ex. She didn't expect me, and honestly she was pissed that I showed up. (I know, right?) Her new boyfriend was there, and he was that possessive jerk who tried to boss her around. The party itself was fine—no drama until her mom dropped the trivia announcement. That's where I slid in like a pro. I answered question after question, crushing every one. I out‑scored his whole crew, snagging the $50 Apple gift card. I didn't even need the cash; I just handed it to the runner‑up, walked out with a grin, and let him know I knew her better than he ever could. The guy tried to control who she talked to, when she talked. He was literally a controlling jerk. After the breakup, I told her what happened, and she was like, "Thank you!" He was fuming, embarrassed for days. That's the tea.
